Breaking changes

SDK contract memberBeforeAfter
CloudHsmClusterSkuNamefixed enumOnly declared values are represented.extensible enumUnknown service values are accepted.
CloudHsmClusterSkuName.Standard B10Standard B10Generated public member identityStandardB10Wire value remains "Standard B10".
Why this is breaking: The language-neutral public enum member identity changes from `Standard B10` to `StandardB10`. Existing generated-SDK source that refers to the prior member can require migration even though its wire value remains `Standard B10`.
